issues.what: the rock is a smeared, melted procedural texture with stretched and doubled blocks; the crisp layered ledges of -a with their wet, sharp edges are gone
issues.fix: rebuild the cliff as sharp, stepped, wet ledges with real fracture detail matching -a

issues.where: the cliff surfaces across the frame
issues.what: there are no white guano streaks running down the ledges, and the bright orange lichen patches have become dull brown smudges
issues.fix: add the dense white guano drips down every ledge and restore crisp, saturated orange-yellow lichen patches

issues.where: the base of the cliff and the ledges
issues.what: the dark hanging kelp and nest seaweed are missing; the bottom band is a dark, warped, liquid-looking smear
issues.fix: hang thick olive-brown kelp along the base and put tangled seaweed nests on the ledges

issues.what: the colony is sparse, a dozen birds scattered where -a has a packed rookery on every ledge, and there are only a few specks in the sky instead of a big circling flock
issues.fix: pack the ledges with roosting creatures in rows and fill the sky with a dense flock that thins with distance

issues.what: a huge, sharp, near-looking sheer cliff wall replaces the distant curved, hazed, bird-covered arch of -a; depth and atmospheric falloff are lost
issues.fix: make it a curving sea-stack arch set far back, softened and lightened by haze and topped with birds

issues.what: the light is flat and evenly bright with a pale, washed-out grade; -a has a moody storm light with dark blue-grey cloud and wet highlights on the rock
issues.fix: darken and cool the sky, add contrast and specular wet sheen on the rock, and keep the warm lichen as the colour accent

issues.where: the roosting creatures at lower right and centre
issues.what: the creatures are an uncanny bleached-white, with crumpled wings like paper, standing on stilt legs, and they do not sit into the rock; in -a they are a weathered tan-grey with translucent veined wings, hunched in nests
issues.fix: warm and darken the creatures to tan-grey, make the wing membranes translucent and veined, and seat them in nests with contact shadows

issues.where: the sky upper right and the spray
issues.what: the break of sunlight in -a is missing, so the spray has no backlight; the spray reads as flat grey CG smoke instead of bright, sunlit, glittering water
issues.fix: open a bright sun break in the clouds at upper right and backlight the spray and wave crest so they glow white

issues.what: the stacks are straight, conical horn spikes; -a has tall, curved, arching rock fins that lean and are veiled in spray
issues.fix: reshape them into tall curving fins leaning into the frame, softened by spray haze

issues.where: the foreground and the tidal flat
issues.what: the flat is a smooth grey plane with a few bare, rounded boulders; the wet sheen, sky reflections, scattered weed-covered stones and out-of-focus seaweed rocks in the near foreground of -a are all missing
issues.fix: make the flat a shallow reflective sheet with glinting highlights, scatter olive weed clumps across it and put dark, defocused, weed-covered rocks in the near foreground

issues.what: the cliffs are smooth, dull, blobby CG masses with a visible texture seam on the left; -a's cliffs are wet and streaked with hanging golden-brown kelp that catches the light
issues.fix: give the cliffs real fractured geometry with wet specular sheen and draped kelp, and remove the seam

issues.what: the creatures are a saturated orange-brown under flat light with stiff poses; in -a they are pale grey-tan and backlit with bright wing edges, skimming low over the water
issues.fix: desaturate them toward grey-tan, add rim light from the sun break and loosen the wing poses into a gliding skim

issues.where: the water plane at right, near the landing creature
issues.what: black horizontal line artifacts run across the water, and the creature's feet have no contact or splash
issues.fix: remove the line artifacts and add reflections and small splashes where the feet touch the water

issues.what: the frame is low-contrast and milky grey; -a has deep blacks in the rock, silver highlights on the water and a storm-lit contrast
issues.fix: deepen the shadows in the rock and foreground, lift the specular highlights on water and spray, and keep a cool silver-grey palette
